title: Instrumental Transfer Learning for Solution Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.41262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data-driven learning for the solution operator of a differential equation has broad scientific importance, but observations from a target system are often scarce and costly to collect. Related source systems may provide abundant observations under similar physical conditions, whereas even small changes in the governing equation can induce complex changes in the solution operator, making naive data pooling ineffective. We propose a structured transfer learning method that accounts for unknown sparse differences in the governing equations from a known library of candidate terms. Using the resolvent identity and a whitened instrumental variable approach, we construct unbiased source estimating equations for the target operator. Building on these equations, we develop a three-stage estimator that consists of a target-only ridge pilot, source-wise sparse calibration, and a projected refit designed to remove the leading calibration error inh

translated_title: 面向解算子的工具变量迁移学习方法
translated_abstract: 微分方程解算子的数据驱动学习具有广泛的科学意义，但来自目标系统的观测数据往往稀缺且采集成本高昂。相关的源系统在相似物理条件下可以提供大量观测数据，然而控制方程即使发生微小变化，也可能引起解算子的复杂变化，使得简单的数据池化方法失效。我们提出了一种结构化迁移学习方法，该方法能够处理控制方程中相对于已知候选项库的未知稀疏差异。利用预解恒等式和白化工具变量方法，我们为目标算子构造了无偏的源估计方程。基于这些方程，我们开发了一个三阶段估计器，包括仅使用目标数据的岭回归初步估计、按源系统的稀疏校准，以及旨在消除主要校准误差的投影重拟合。
tldr: 提出了一种基于预解恒等式和白化工具变量的三阶段结构化迁移学习方法，能够在目标系统观测稀缺时，利用相关源系统数据无偏地学习微分方程的解算子。
en_tdlr: A three-stage structured transfer learning method based on the resolvent identity and whitened instrumental variables is proposed to unbiasedly learn solution operators of differential equations by leveraging data from related source systems when target observations are scarce.
